subject.title: fix(release): bind npm publishing to approved package bytes

question: Do the release-manager owners approve requiring exact preflight_run_id plus preflight_run_attempt evidence for npm and broad publication dispatches?
rationale: The change is technically sound but intentionally tightens a release security boundary and changes the operator invocation contract owned by @openclaw/openclaw-release-managers.

options.title: Approve strict binding
options.body: Require the exact run and attempt throughout publication, correct the proof citation, and land after the final exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Preserve legacy dispatch temporarily
options.body: Keep run-ID-only invocation during a compatibility window, accepting continued attempt ambiguity until a separate migration plan is approved.

options.title: Pause for combined release review
options.body: Hold this PR until the adjacent release-evidence reuse design and permanent publication trust contract can be reviewed together.

recommendation.title: Approve strict binding
recommendation.body: Require the exact run and attempt throughout publication, correct the proof citation, and land after the final exact-head checks pass.
